name: proxy_patterns
description: Unprotected UUPS upgrade authorization allowing arbitrary implementation takeover
question: The source file in `source` defines a contract that inherits from an upgradeable proxy base (e.g., UUPSUpgradeable) and overrides the `_authorizeUpgrade` function, but that function lacks any access-control check (such as an onlyOwner or role-based modifier) restricting who may call it, allowing any external caller to upgrade the proxy's implementation and take control of or corrupt the contract's logic and storage.
criteria: Contract inherits UUPSUpgradeable (or similar upgradeable proxy base) and defines _authorizeUpgrade
_authorizeUpgrade body is empty or contains no access-control modifier/check
No onlyOwner, onlyRole, or equivalent permission check guards the upgrade function
No require/revert statement validating msg.sender identity before allowing upgrade
Upgrade function is reachable by external/public callers without restriction
